general_information.Description: This course will cover both classic and current theories of group communication that focus on "how groups work" and include practical information on group communication strategies and skills that emphasize "how to work in groups". Topics included: group development, group membership, group diversity, group leadership, group motivation, conflict and cohesion in groups, planning and conducting meetings and making presentations in groups. Learning in the class will be facilitated through the use of vehicles such as textbook readings, class discussion, exercises/in-class activities, cases and lectures.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: LO1: Define common teamwork skills such as group communication, membership, leadership, listening, planning and conducting meeting, verbal and nonverbal communication, conflict and cohesion, problem solving.
LO2: Identify key elements, advantages, disavantages and the nature of group communication.
LO3: Recognise the principles that help balance the group's activities and ethical issues.
LO4: Describe stages of group development and types of group norms.
LO5: Discuss the goals of the group and how to encourage effective group work
LO6: Explain why member join, stay or leave groups through theory of needs.
LO7: Determine group roles and how each role helps hinders groups from achieving a common goal.
LO8: Describe and apply strategies for reducing communication apprehensions.
LO9: Understand how to become an assertive members and learn how to balance between passivity and aggression.
LO10: Analyse ways to become effective and powerful leaders.
LO11: Understand leadership theories and model of leadership effectiveness.
LO12: Describe importance of verbal and nonverbal in teamwork and how to use them effectiveness.
LO13: Identify differences the use of nonverbal communication with gender and culture.
LO14: Discriminate defensive and supportive behaviors and the way to create a supportive communication climate.
LO15: Identify the challenges and types of listening in groups.
LO16: Describe skills and strategies to effective listening in group.
LO17: Discuss differences of listening with factors that gender, personality, cultural, hearing ability.
LO18: Understand how conflicts appear in groups and how to manage them in cohesion.
LO19: Identify decision making skills and problem solving theories
LO20:Apply structured and creative problem solving skills to solve group problems.
LO21: Illustrate and analyze problem solving by critical thinking skills with cooperative argumentations.
LO22: Develop a professtional meeting and practice dealing the behavior problems of members in the meeting time.
LO23: Identify the nature of vitural groups, synchronous and ayhchronous goupware
LO24: Discuss group diversity demensions affect to virtual groups, such as age, geography, income.
LO25: Apply of parliamentary principles and summary the basic procedures when organizing the meeting.
